verdict.rationale: Adyen's own marketing says platforms can 'Control fees' from the Dashboard, and the split-payment docs let the platform deduct costs and route funds to its own liable balance account. That amounts to a documented way to set the sell rate sellers see. Nothing in the pack covers a published buy rate or interchange-level cost visibility for managing the spread. missing for 10: documented buy rate/pricing from Adyen, interchange-level (e.g. interchange++) cost visibility or reporting, detailed docs on configuring seller-facing fee schedules, independent corroboration

support.subject: As a finance lead, I control the economics — a documented buy rate from the provider and freedom to set the sell rate my sellers see, with interchange-level cost visibility to manage the spread

citations.quote: Control fees and use payments as a competitive edge, all managed in your Adyen Dashboard.
You can split the payments between one or more users, deduct costs as needed, and hold funds until payout.
you have to include instructions on how to split the funds between your user's balance accounts and your marketplace's liable balance account.
